name: tempo
description: TEMPO: Timed Event Measurement and Period Observer — frequency and period counter

registers.name: FREQ
registers.desc: edge count during last completed gate window

registers.name: PERIOD
registers.desc: sys_clk cycles between last two rising edges

registers.name: STATUS
registers.desc: bit 0 = gate active, bit 1 = freq valid, bit 2 = period valid
